tagline: A step-by-step wizard for forming a Pennsylvania / Philadelphia nonprofit — checklist, board, AI-drafted governing documents and a filing tracker.
summary: My Nonprofit walks a founder through forming a nonprofit in Pennsylvania and Philadelphia. Each **formation case** is one organization: a 12-step PA/Philadelphia checklist with per-step status, board members and officers, a set of facts about the organization, and a filing tracker where you record what you've submitted.

From those facts, Claude drafts the governing documents — mission statement, articles of incorporation, bylaws, conflict-of-interest policy and board consent — as reviewable drafts you can edit and export to Markdown. It never files anything for you and isn't legal advice. Data lives in a Supabase project you control.
audience: Founders starting a nonprofit in Pennsylvania, especially Philadelphia.
Advisors helping several groups through formation (one case per organization).
You can create a Supabase project and get an Anthropic key.
notFor: Other states — the checklist and drafts are PA/Philadelphia-specific.
Filing with PA DOS, the IRS or Philly eCLIPSE — status is tracked manually.
Legal advice — drafts are starting points for review by a professional.

capabilities.title: Getting started wizard
capabilities.detail: `/getting-started` and `/setup` check Supabase connectivity (`GET /api/setup/status`) before you begin.

capabilities.title: Organization facts
capabilities.detail: `/formation-facts-page` captures the details documents are drafted from.

capabilities.title: AI document drafts
capabilities.detail: `/formation-detail-page/documents`: mission, articles, bylaws, conflict policy and board consent, exportable as Markdown.

capabilities.title: Prompts, costs and API docs
capabilities.detail: `/ai-prompts` (editable per document type), `/ai-costs` (exchange registry ledger) and `/docs/api`.

components.name: Console
components.owns: Landing, setup wizard, cases, checklist, board, documents, filings, prompts and costs. Next rewrites API calls to `EXPRESS_API_URL` and can add `FORMATION_API_SECRET` server-side.

components.name: API
components.stack: Express + TypeScript, Supabase JS, Anthropic SDK
components.owns: Formation cases, checklist, board, case fields/facts, documents, filings, AI prompts and the exchange registry in your Supabase project; AI drafting.
components.doesNotOwn: User accounts — single trusted operator, optional shared secret.

dataFlow: Run `docs/supabase-setup.sql` in your Supabase project (schema, checklist seed, AI prompts, error logs).
The console calls same-origin routes that Next rewrites to Express (`EXPRESS_API_URL`).
Express reads/writes Supabase with the service role key.
Drafting a document sends case facts and board info plus the stored prompt to Anthropic; each exchange is logged with cost.

trust.title: Browser
trust.detail: No secrets; never talks to Supabase or Anthropic directly.

trust.title: API (your machine)
trust.detail: Supabase service role and `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY`. Binds to 127.0.0.1.

trust.title: Supabase / Anthropic
trust.detail: Your formation data lives in your Supabase project; facts are sent to Anthropic when drafting.

commonTasks.title: First-time setup
steps: Create a Supabase project and run `docs/supabase-setup.sql` in its SQL editor.
Set `EXPRESS_API_URL` on the console to the API's real port.

commonTasks.title: Form a nonprofit
steps: Create a case and fill in facts on `/formation-facts-page`.
Draft each document, review and edit, then export Markdown.
Work through the checklist and record filings as you submit them.

commonTasks.title: Adjust how documents are drafted
commonTasks.when: Drafts need a different tone or structure.
steps: Open `/ai-prompts`, pick the document type and edit the prompt.

troubleshooting.symptom: Setup check says Supabase is unreachable
troubleshooting.fix: Check `SUPABASE_URL` / service role key and that `docs/supabase-setup.sql` ran.
`FORMATION_API_SECRET` is set on one side but not the other.
`EXPRESS_API_URL` defaults to 127.0.0.1:3080; under Hub the API may be on 3034.

glossary.definition: One nonprofit being formed, with its checklist, board, facts, documents and filings.
Key details (name, purpose, address, …) used to draft documents.
Manual record of what's been submitted to the state, IRS or city.

hubNotes: README ports (API 3080, console 3081) clash with code-control's storage (3080) and other storage servers on 3081; the registry gives 3034 / 3035 — set `PORT` and `EXPRESS_API_URL` to match.
No local Postgres — data lives in your Supabase project, so Hub's database setup doesn't apply.
The express `docs/` folder has a full guide set (overview, architecture, schema, setup).
